The offer was reported by Premium Times Nigeria. The article text provided contains only the headline and no further details on terms, amounts or timelines.

cards.headline: Oando closes at N39.90 after full-bid demand on rights issue announcement day
cards.what_happened: Oando Plc closed at N39.90 per share on Friday, November 27, 2026, up 9.92% on the day, after announcing the final terms of its N203.8 billion rights issue. The company is offering 4.076 billion new ordinary shares at N50 per share, one new share for every two held by qualifying shareholders.
key_facts: Oando closed at N39.90 per share on Friday, November 27, 2026, gaining N3.60 or 9.92% from N36.30.
Oando announced the final terms of its N203.8 billion rights issue on Friday following regulatory approvals.
The rights issue offers 4.076 billion new ordinary shares at N50 per share, one new share for every two existing shares.
Investors traded 17,364,939 Oando shares worth N691.87 million across 491 deals on Friday.
analysis: Why it matters: The rights issue would increase Oando's share capital and shareholding base, and the proceeds are intended for upstream oil and gas investment, working capital and debt repayment. Shareholders face a gap between the N50 subscription price and the N39.90 market close when deciding whether to subscribe.

cards.headline: NCC flags 1.58m fake IMEIs in nationwide crackdown on counterfeit phones
cards.what_happened: The Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC) has flagged 1.58 million fake IMEI numbers in a nationwide crackdown on counterfeit phones. The action targets devices using counterfeit identifiers on Nigerian networks.

cards.headline: CBN plans new regulatory rulebook to strengthen banking oversight
cards.what_happened: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) plans to introduce a comprehensive regulatory rulebook in 2027 aimed at strengthening banking oversight. The article's text is truncated, so further details on the rulebook's scope are not available.
key_facts: The Central Bank of Nigeria plans to introduce a comprehensive regulatory rulebook in 2027.
analysis: Why it matters: A new CBN rulebook could change compliance obligations for banks and their corporate shareholders, which affects ownership and governance transparency in the sector.
